description: This file defines a class `_PROXY_LiteLLMManagedFiles` that manages LiteLLM managed files within a FastAPI-based project. It includes methods for storing, retrieving, deleting, and processing managed files, including handling base64 conversion of files stored in external storage backends. The class interacts with a database via Prisma, caching mechanisms, and external services, facilitating file management and access control in a language model proxy environment.
